name: "Deep Sea" Graham Cracker Treats with Vanilla Icing & Gummy Sea Creatures (Kid-Friendly)

instructions.primary_message: This recipe contains steps that can be done by smaller hands! You know your child (and their cooking abilities) best, so get them involved where you feel comfortable. Have fun!

Place graham crackers in a resealable plastic bag and have fun crushing them into "sand." (Use your hands, a flat-bottomed glass, rolling pin, or small saucepan to help!) Transfer to a small bowl and set aside.
Place frosting and food coloring in another small bowl, then mix well, adding additional food coloring, to get your desired color.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ (16 oz) tub vanilla frosting
2 drop blue food coloring

instructions.primary_message: Remove additional graham crackers from their sleeves (keeping them as long rectangles) and evenly spread with colored icing. Sprinkle some graham cracker sand at the bottom, then create your ocean scene with fish candies, shark candies, "starfish" sprinkles, and using the gel icing to make "seaweed." Get creative and have fun!
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ cup gummy fish candy
¼ cup gummy shark candy
1 tbsp candy sprinkles
1 (1.3 oz) tube green writing icing or gel

instructions.primary_message: Divide decorated graham crackers between plates and enjoy!
